struct ble_store_value_sec { ble_addr_t peer_addr;uint16_t bond_count;uint8_t key_size,ltk[16],ltk_present,authenticated; };
struct ble_store_value_cccd { ble_addr_t peer_addr;uint16_t chr_val_handle,flags; };
